Overview of Dataset

```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(ggplot2)

# Load the data
activity <- read.csv("activity.csv")

# Convert date column to Date format
activity$date <- as.Date(activity$date)

# Inspect the data
head(activity)
```

Mean total of steps taken

```{r}
# Calculate total steps per day
total_steps_per_day <- aggregate(steps ~ date, data = activity, sum, na.rm = TRUE)

# Plot histogram
ggplot(total_steps_per_day, aes(x = steps)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1000, fill = "blue", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Total Steps Per Day", x = "Steps", y = "Frequency")

# Calculate mean and median
mean_steps <- mean(total_steps_per_day$steps, na.rm = TRUE)
median_steps <- median(total_steps_per_day$steps, na.rm = TRUE)

mean_steps
median_steps
```

Average Daily Activity Pattern

```{r}
# Average steps per interval
avg_steps_per_interval <- aggregate(steps ~ interval, data = activity, mean, na.rm = TRUE)

# Plot time series
ggplot(avg_steps_per_interval, aes(x = interval, y = steps)) +
  geom_line(color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Average Daily Activity Pattern", x = "Interval", y = "Average Steps")

# Identify interval with maximum steps
max_interval <- avg_steps_per_interval[which.max(avg_steps_per_interval$steps), ]
max_interval
```

Input Missing Values

```{r}

# Count missing values
num_missing <- sum(is.na(activity$steps))

# Impute missing values
imputed_activity <- activity
imputed_activity$steps[is.na(imputed_activity$steps)] <- 
  with(activity, ave(steps, interval, FUN = function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)))

# Repeat histogram and summary stats
imputed_total_steps_per_day <- aggregate(steps ~ date, data = imputed_activity, sum)
mean_imputed_steps <- mean(imputed_total_steps_per_day$steps)
median_imputed_steps <- median(imputed_total_steps_per_day$steps)

mean_imputed_steps
median_imputed_steps
```

Weekday vs. weekend Activity

```{r}
# Add weekday/weekend variable
imputed_activity$day_type <- ifelse(weekdays(imputed_activity$date) %in% c("Saturday", "Sunday"), "weekend", "weekday")

# Average steps per interval by day type
avg_steps_day_type <- aggregate(steps ~ interval + day_type, data = imputed_activity, mean)

# Plot panel
library(lattice)
xyplot(steps ~ interval | day_type, data = avg_steps_day_type, type = "l", layout = c(1, 2),
       main = "Activity Patterns: Weekday vs. Weekend", xlab = "Interval", ylab = "Average Steps")
```
